ui.beammp.accounts.Banner2: Recover your old account before logging in old passwords no longer work. Click Read More for recovery instructions.
ui.beammp.accounts.recoveryIntro: All accounts must go through Account Recovery before you can log in. All passwords have been reset, so your old password will not work.
ui.beammp.accounts.recoveryStep2: Enter the email address associated with your BeamMP account, then select Recover Account.
ui.beammp.accounts.recoveryStep3: If you don't receive an email, check your spam folder. If no email arrives, try another email address you may have used or create a new account.
ui.beammp.accounts.recoveryException: Early Access Supporters who have already recovered their accounts do not need to repeat this process.
ui.beammp.accounts.afterRecoveryText: You can log in and play, or update your BeamMP Account Profile and link services such as Discord and Patreon.
ui.beammp.accounts.keymasterText: After recovering your account, use the Keymaster link at the top of the accounts portal. Link your Discord account there to migrate your keys to your BeamMP Account.
